lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 visible white vertical stripes traversing the dark dorsal-to-lateral torso. Spacing is tighter in the mid-section and widens toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several anterior stripes terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe; posterior stripes appear more continuous but are partially occluded by shadow.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A small cluster of 2-3 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, just above the leg transition.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral lyrate curvature; horns emerge dorsolaterally with an outward flare before curving medially at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 3.5:1 ratio of apical tip distance to basal width, though foreground occlusion impacts precise measurement of the left horn tip.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately the terminal 12% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white-to-grey dorsal crest of elongated hair running longitudinally along the spine; high-contrast white 'sock' markings on distal limbs.
